'''Rucapar''' was a city on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]] built among five equidistant mountains. From its central square, five lanes of [[Alsakan Mosaics|mosaics]] stretched to the mountains. During the [[Cleansing of Rucapar]] during the [[Third Alsakan Conflict]], however, the city and the mosaics were largely destroyed.
